You are operating under the SJL Sovereign Cloud file governance doctrine. Apply all rules below before
modifying, creating, naming, versioning, or publishing any governed file.

---

## Agent Constitution (CLAUDE.md directives)

- Use rootless Podman under the dedicated `sjl` service user.
- Use systemd Quadlets for durable services. Never use Docker, docker-compose, or `sudo podman`.
- Treat DOCID as permanent identity; never use path as identity.
- Apply the five-digit PARA hierarchy to all governed directories.
- Apply the canonical filename: `[PPPPP]_YYYY-MM-DD__DOCID__semantic-title__vMAJOR-MINOR__sha8.ext`
- Never overwrite changed canonical content without:
  1. Calculating SHA-256
  2. Preserving the prior version
  3. Incrementing the version
  4. Creating a diff
  5. Updating embedded metadata, xattrs, and sidecar
  6. Updating the registry and Hook ID
  7. Mirroring and checksum-verifying the bundle
  8. Publishing the change to BookStack and archiving the governed record to PaperParrot
- Never expose or echo secrets.
- Never modify excluded OS, database, cache, container, package, or temporary paths.
- Never perform a bulk rename or migration without a dry run, backup, manifest, and rollback plan.
- Do not mark work complete until tests, service health, remote checksums, and documentation publication are verified.

---

## Canonical Naming Convention

```
[PPPPP]_YYYY-MM-DD__DOCID__semantic-title__vMAJOR-MINOR__sha8.ext
```

| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| PPPPP | Five-digit PARA classification |
| YYYY-MM-DD | Authoritative creation or document date |
| DOCID | Permanent identity — never changes |
| semantic-title | Hyphen-delimited, derived from OCR/vision/metadata/user |
| vMAJOR-MINOR | Immutable content version, hyphen-separated |
| sha8 | First 8 characters of SHA-256 digest |
| ext | Lowercase normalized extension |

Example: `02000_2026-06-19__SJL-CLOUD-0017__persistent-metadata-manual__v7-2__843dc901.pdf`

---

## Five-Digit PARA Structure

| Code | Category | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| 01000 | INBOX | Controlled intake, staging, and review |
| 02000 | PROJECTS | Active finite projects and deliverables |
| 03000 | AREAS | Ongoing responsibilities and operations |
| 04000 | RESOURCES | Reference material and reusable assets |
| 05000 | ARCHIVES | Inactive, completed, and retained records |
| 06000 | PRIVATE MEDIA | Restricted media and sensitive assets |
| 07000 | SYSTEM AUTOMATION | Scripts, agents, Quadlets, manifests, and manuals |
| 08000 | APPLICATION DATA | Governed application exports and controlled state |
| 09000 | QUARANTINE | Failures, conflicts, unsupported files, review-required |

## Universal File Governance Pipeline

```
discover → stabilize → identify → analyze → version → diff → rename
         → sidecar → hook → mirror → register → publish
```

Required native actions:
`stabilize_write` · `calculate_hash` · `assign_docid` · `extract_metadata` · `run_ocr`
`run_vision` · `classify_para` · `snapshot_previous` · `increment_version` · `generate_diff`

`register_hook` · `mirror_object` · `verify_remote_checksum` · `update_registry`
`update_bookstack` · `archive_paperparrot` · `quarantine`

## Persistent Metadata Layers

| Layer | Purpose | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| Canonical filename | Human-readable minimum recovery data | Always present |
| Embedded metadata | Portable metadata inside supported formats | Write when safe |
| Extended attributes | Fast local lookup | Reconstructable |
| Sidecar JSON | Complete portable file-level metadata | Mandatory |
| Central registry | Current state, paths, versions, links | Authoritative |
| Cloud object metadata | Off-device recovery and integrity | Mandatory for mirrors |

**Canonical file bundle:**
```
file.ext
file.ext.sjl.json
file.ext.sha256
.sidecars/DOCID/ocr.txt
.sidecars/DOCID/vision.json
.sidecars/DOCID/provenance.json
.sidecars/DOCID/links.json
.sidecars/DOCID/mirror-manifest.json
.sidecars/DOCID/diffs/
```

---

## Versioning Rules

- Path and filename are mutable. DOCID is permanent identity.
- A new file receives a DOCID once; moves/renames update path record only.
- Any byte-level content change creates a new immutable version.
- Metadata-only changes create metadata events without incrementing content version.
- The prior canonical version is always preserved before replacement.
- Version chain must remain complete and recoverable.

```
v1-0  initial ingestion
v1-1  first content modification
v2-0  intentional major revision or transformation
```

## Mandatory Discovery Commands (run before any migration)

```bash
hostnamectl && uname -a && df -h / && free -h
ss -tulpn
tailscale status
podman ps --all --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'
podman network ls
systemctl --user list-units --type=service --all
systemctl --user list-timers --all
find /srv/sjl /data /opt ~/.config/containers/systemd -maxdepth 6 -print
find /srv/sjl /opt -type f \( -iname 'CLAUDE.md' -o -iname 'filewarden*.py' -o -iname '*.container' \)
git -C /srv/sjl/07000_SYSTEM-AUTOMATION status --short --branch
rclone listremotes
```

## Change Classification & Approval Gates

| Class | Examples | Action | Approval |
|---|---|---|---|
| A – Read only | Inventory, status, diffs, docs review | Execute and report | None |
| B – Reversible config | Quadlet, NPM route, non-secret config | Backup → patch → test → deploy | Record change |
| C – Stateful | DB schema, registry migration, volume move | Dry run → dump → test → restore test | Explicit approval |
| D – Destructive | Bulk rename, delete, firewall, credential replace | Generate plan only | Explicit approval + rollback gate |

## Branch, Commit, and Artifact Naming

```
Branch:    claude/07000-YYYY-MM-DD-short-change-slug
Commit:    [07000][DOCID][vMAJOR-MINOR] imperative change summary
Artifact:  [PPPPP]_YYYY-MM-DD__DOCID__semantic-title__vMAJOR-MINOR__sha8.ext
Migration: 07000_YYYY-MM-DD__MIGRATION-DOCID__scope-manifest__vX-Y__sha8.json
Rollback:  07000_YYYY-MM-DD__ROLLBACK-DOCID__scope-rollback__vX-Y__sha8.sh
```

## Role Separation

| Claude Code | Inspect, plan, write, test, migrate, document, submit controlled changes |
| FileWarden | Continuous file detection and governance transactions |
| n8n | Workflow orchestration, approvals, notifications, retries |

## Integrity Audit Checklist

- [ ] Canonical file exists
- [ ] Filename hash matches file content
- [ ] Sidecar exists and validates against schema
- [ ] Sidecar digest matches the registry
- [ ] Embedded DOCID matches the sidecar
- [ ] Extended-attribute DOCID matches the sidecar (where xattrs supported)
- [ ] Registry version matches filename version
- [ ] Cloud object and associated metadata exist
- [ ] Remote checksum matches local digest
- [ ] Mirror manifest is current
- [ ] Version chain is complete and unbroken
- [ ] Hook ID resolves to current canonical path
- [ ] BookStack and PaperParrot publication status recorded

bucket/PARA/subarea/DOCID/metadata/
bucket/PARA/subarea/DOCID/manifests/

## Publication Transaction (every completed change)

```
change completed
  → generate canonical Markdown/TXT source
  → generate DOCX/PDF manual
  → calculate SHA-256 and rename artifacts
  → publish current manual/change page to BookStack
  → ingest PDF/TXT/manifest into PaperParrot
  → apply document type, PARA tags, version, DOCID, retention metadata
  → verify BookStack URL and PaperParrot document ID
  → store both references in change ledger and sidecar
```

---

## Final Rule

Claude Code may design and execute controlled changes, but **no change becomes canonical** until
FileWarden/registry state, Git history, backup evidence, service health, cloud checksum verification,
BookStack publication, and PaperParrot archival all agree.
